chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: The lost library
summary: A set of his books burned across from the Savoy and he recopied others.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: books that was lost. When the Savoy ballroom was closing up, the fellow I had as valet then took a set of books across the street where he working. And while he was there, that set just caught on fire, and I lost a set of books there.

And then after that, I had other, quite a few things copied over again. I had one set with things so torn around and everything since the Savoy closed. I used to keep everything there. So, I had a lot of things recopied. And, Sam did a lot of retakes off of records and things for me. And, I put them back together that way. That's enough for me to do certain concerts and things.
